subject: Secure Exec Suite: venue access, private bridge, AV rider and parking passes
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@summitvenue.com>, Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@pacificav.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secure exec suite request - AV + private bridge requirements

Hi Liam / Nadia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. ClientCorp confirmed the exec workshop for Oct 19-20. Before we lock the space, two items are blocking internal approvals:

1) Private conferencing bridge: ClientCorp requires a closed-circuit conference bridge (no public PSTN ingress) and recordings must be stored to a customer-managed S3 bucket with SSE-KMS. Can Summit provision an isolated VLAN and provide STUN/TURN details so Pacific AV can route the bridge?

2) Certified on-prem recording restrictions: recordings must be disabled in public cloud recording services; only on-site NVR with HSM-wrapped keys allowed. Please confirm whether the room rack can host a locked 1U NVR, or if Pacific AV needs to bring a managed appliance.

3) Parking/arrival: Executives will arrive morning of Oct 19 in two cars. We need two reserved parking passes at the loading dock and an escort from security for both drop-off and private exit.

Attached: redwood-av-rider.xlsx with expected device list and site-plan_A-level.pdf showing rack access.

Can you confirm feasibility and any lead-time for the NVR/HSM box? If Summit can’t host, what are logistics for Pacific AV to install a tamper-evident appliance and hand over the HSM key material at check-in?

Regards,
Marcus
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
---
redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123
From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@summitvenue.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nadia Chen <nadia.chen@pacificav.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure exec suite request - AV + private bridge requirements

Marcus — thanks for the clear notes. Short answers:

- VLAN/Bridge: We can provision an isolated VLAN with ACLs to restrict outbound traffic; we have a private bridge option that terminates on-site (no PSTN gateway). I will share the STUN/TURN and private peering IPs by EOD.

- 1U rack: There is room in Rack B (secure cage). We can house a customer-supplied 1U NVR. Our security team requires a chain-of-custody form at delivery and HSM key material must be transferred in-person.

- Parking: We have two reserved loading passes near the rear service entrance; security will provide an escort for arrival and exit.

One thing to flag: our on-site network uses a central firewall managed by Summit. Pacific AV will need a signed network access form and a scheduled maintenance window (30–60 mins) to attach their appliance to the isolated VLAN.

I'll attach the standard access/COC form and propose a timeline after Nadia confirms AV staffing.

— Liam
Venue Operations Manager, SummitVenue Corp
(415) 555-7042

All — quick AV ops thoughts after reviewing the rider:

- We can supply a tamper-evident 1U NVR with on-site HSM wrapping (Yubikey + offline key transfer) and place it in Rack B. Lead time for the appliance is ~7 business days.

- Network handshake: Pacific AV will need a temporary MAC/IP reservation in the isolated VLAN. Please confirm the maintenance window; we prefer testing on the 17th (two days prior) in the AM to validate bridge connectivity and a short call with ClientCorp’s security team.

- Recording policy: We will implement a recording policy that disables cloud upload. Local recordings will be encrypted using AES-256 and the encryption key will be exported to an HSM-wrapped package handed to ClientCorp at the end of the event. We will provide a written procedure for chain-of-custody.

- On-site contact: I’ll be the lead technician onsite (mobile: 415-555-9009). Will need a single point-of-contact from ClientCorp for HSM handoff — can we have name/ID by Oct 1?

If Summit can send the network access form, we’ll complete and return it same-day.

Thanks,
Nadia
Pacific AV — Technical Director

Thanks both — that addresses the technical ask. A few logistics items from my side:

- Parking passes: please reserve two rear-loading passes for Oct 19, 07:30–10:30 local time. I’ve attached parking-pass-invite.pdf with the vehicle makes. Security escort required.

- Test window: Confirming Pacific AV can test on Oct 17 at 09:00 PT; please send invitations to Oliver Rees (ClientCorp security) and our network lead Aditya Rao. Oliver — can you confirm your availability for a 30-min test slot?

- Docs: Liam — please send the chain-of-custody and network access form by Monday 14 Sep so we can route to procurement and ClientCorp’s security for signatures.

- Contingency: if the NVR is delayed, we will use Summit’s dedicated on-site recorder but require immediate physical handoff of key material post-event; this must be agreed in writing.

I’ll prepare a one-page ops summary for ClientCorp and loop in security approvals.

Best,
